items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: He came up there and sat in. We played some tunes on a Saturday afternoon in the, on the stand, in the Cinderella ballroom.

ctx.x: if she knew anything about Bix's life at all. I mean... Apparently not, because in the first

place she wouldn't write about him. Well, just like this guy, I suppose he's gonna say if he's ever crossed up that, that, that was just, he was, it was an inspiration, that it wasn't supposed to be Bix. He better state it, because it's definitely a bunch of damn lies in the thing, and this girl doesn't say that it was fact. She doesn't infer that there was any truth to it. Just that his playing inspired her to write the book, period. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Did you want to hear about when we heard the sad news that Bix…
way that he didn't fit in one bit. Well, he was a New Orleans person. Yes, he said.
